optimization.claims: Separate price, probability and interval heads are evaluated on a later 90-day test. Historical data is development evidence; no prospective superiority or automatic model promotion is claimed.
optimization.schedule: Weekly short-window review; monthly all-window refit; hourly saved-model inference only.
optimization.promotion_gate: Retain incumbent until same-origin prospective comparisons, at least 20 non-overlapping settled windows, and calendar-block uncertainty support improvement without material price/probability/coverage regression.
